cases.name: a-tag-inside-data-is-text-not-a-mistake
cases.description: The deliberate exception. <data>x<b/>y</data> renders x<b/>y, which is how a config emits XML or HTML — so nothing is reported here, and that silence is the feature.

cases.name: an-open-close-gen-is-the-same-generator
cases.description: <gen …></gen> is the ordinary alternative spelling of <gen …/>, and must be accepted. Four of the five refused it and blamed the sequence — "has no <gen> child" about a <gen> standing in plain sight — because their collectors only ever looked at the self-closing form.

cases.name: the-per-line-fixtures-see-output-lines-not-line-elements
cases.description: A <line each="Items"> produces one OUTPUT line per element, and <delimiter_line> is documented as sitting "between the lines of a record". It used to sit between the <line> ELEMENTS, so between the repetitions of an each= line it produced nothing at all — which is exactly why a JSON array of objects could not be written: no comma between the members, and no word about it. The delimiter now falls between consecutive output lines, whether they came from different <line> elements or from the same one repeated. Every element of Items is the same value on purpose: the case is about WHERE the fixture falls, not about what was drawn.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="ord" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Items"><gen type="text" value="x" repeat="3" separator=","/></sequence><delimiter_line><line><data>,</data></line></delimiter_line><delimiter_block><line><data>--</data></line></delimiter_block></env><block><line each="Items"><data>[${{Items}}]</data></line><line><data>total</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-delimiter-follows-the-lines-that-survive
cases.description: The delimiter goes between the lines that SURVIVE an if=, not between the ones that were written — otherwise a suppressed middle line leaves a stray comma standing where nothing is.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="x"/></sequence><delimiter_line><line><data>,</data></line></delimiter_line></env><block><line><data>first</data></line><line if="A == nothing"><data>never</data></line><line><data>last</data></line></block></tdc>
